newsitem.title: USA: CME July pork bellies tumble near limit.
newsitem.headline: CME July pork bellies tumble near limit.

text.p: CME pork bellies fell for sharp losses with July tumbling for a near limit loss of 2.825 cents per lb before finding support.
Profit taking encouraged by an overbought condition that lifted July and August for limit gains Thursday pushed prices down into sell stops. Locals actively sold on the setback, traders said.
At 0941 CDT, prices recovered somewhat to range from 1.825 cent lower to 0.925 highwer with only February up and July off most at 90.200 cents.
